majors.what: The Edit submenu is `undo, redo, sep, cut, copy, paste` and stops there — no `{ role: 'selectAll' }` (nor `pasteAndMatchStyle` / `delete`). Because `installAppMenu()` calls `Menu.setApplicationMenu(...)` (src/main/menu/appMenu.ts:20), it *replaces* Electron's default menu, which did contain those items (`pasteAndMatchStyle` and the `editMenu` role are both present in the shipped Electron 43.2.0 binary; before this PR no application menu was set, so the default was in effect).
majors.why: This is the surviving half of the r1 blocker. On macOS the standard editing accelerators are delivered through the application menu — that is the entire reason r1's Cut/Copy/Paste fix was needed — so removing Select All plausibly takes Cmd+A away from `#chat-composer` (src/renderer/src/features/chat/ChatPanel.tsx:36), the only text input this PR ships, on a v1-supported platform (11-tech-stack.md:215, macOS 12+). Even in the benign case where Chromium handles Cmd/Ctrl+A internally, the app's Edit menu now visibly lacks Select All, which every editor has. I could NOT verify the macOS keystroke behaviour here (headless WSL, no display, no Mac) — this is stated as a major rather than a blocker for exactly that reason. Note the wireframe spec (20-ui-wireframes.md:44-49) also omits Select All, so the PR is spec-conformant; the spec is the thing that is wrong.
majors.fix: Add `{ type: 'separator' }, { role: 'selectAll' }` after `paste` (or replace the hand-rolled list with `{ role: 'editMenu' }`, which is what r1's fix note offered as the one-liner), extend tests/unit/app-menu.test.ts:32's expected role list to match, and add the row to the 20-ui-wireframes.md menu tree so code and spec stay in step.

File items carry clicks and CmdOrCtrl+N/O as intended; last File item is `close` on darwin, `quit` elsewhere; `{role:'appMenu'}` is prepended on darwin only.

H2 (does the new test actually pin the fix?): CONFIRMED it does — copied appMenuTemplate.ts and app-menu.test.ts into a scratch dir, reintroduced the r1 blocker verbatim (custom Undo/Redo/Cut/Copy/Paste with CmdOrCtrl+Z/X/C/V clicks) and ran vitest against the scratch config: 1 failed | 3 passed, `['undo','redo','cut','copy','paste']` vs five `undefined` at app-menu.test.ts:32. The test is a genuine regression guard, not a restatement.

H3 (the other half of the same class): does replacing the default menu drop editing items that used to work? CONFIRMED as the major — Select All / Paste and Match Style / Delete were in Electron's default menu (`grep -a pasteAndMatchStyle node_modules/electron/dist/electron` → 12 hits, `editMenu` → 2) and are absent from the new template. macOS impact unverified.

REJECTED — grep over src/ and tests/ finds no reader at all; src/preload/index.ts exposes only `{version}`, and `IPC_EVENT_CHANNELS`/`isIpcEventChannel` are unaffected (smoke.test.ts:19 still green). REJECTED — src/shared/ipc-contract.ts gained only a `const` string tuple and a derived union (no imports at all); src/main/menu/* import from src/shared with type-only imports for the electron and MenuAction types; no renderer file imports src/main or electron; no new oxlint-disable anywhere in the diff. oxlint exits 0.

REJECTED — the four test paths (smoke.test.ts, app-menu.test.ts, document/*.test.ts, app-shell.test.tsx) each match exactly one project, and both projects exit 0. notes.summary: Round 2 fixes every r1 finding it set out to fix, and fixes them properly: the Edit menu is now pure Electron roles, the restructure matches 10-architecture.md §1.3 name-for-name, MenuAction lives in the shared contract with a test that keeps the union and the menu in sync, and the new app-menu test is a real regression guard (I reintroduced the r1 blocker in a scratch copy and watched it go red). What survives is the other half of the same bug: replacing Electron's default menu also deleted Select All, which on macOS is the platform where menu-driven editing accelerators matter. One line to add, one row to add to the wireframe, and this ships.
